description: This file defines constants, data classes, and functions related to launching an assistant within an Android application. It includes intent parsing logic to handle specific actions such as 'ASK_OPENCLAW' and 'ACTION_ASSIST'.

classes.name: HomeDestination
classes.description: Enumeration representing different destinations or screens in the app (Connect, Chat, Voice, Screen, Settings).

classes.name: AssistantLaunchRequest
classes.description: Data class encapsulating details of an assistant launch request, including source, prompt, and autoSend flag.

methods.name: parseAssistantLaunchIntent
methods.description: Function that parses an Android Intent to create an AssistantLaunchRequest object based on the intent's action and extras.
